title: Game Patch Impact & Player Sentiment Intelligence Input

steamAppIds.title: Steam App IDs
steamAppIds.description: Steam App IDs to analyze. Example: 646570.

comparisonMode.title: Comparison mode
comparisonMode.description: Compare recent periods, detect the latest likely patch, or use a custom patch date.

patchDate.title: Patch date
patchDate.description: Required only for custom patch date mode. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

windowDays.title: Days per period
windowDays.description: Number of days in each before and after period.

maxReviewsPerPeriod.title: Reviews per period
maxReviewsPerPeriod.description: Maximum number of deterministically sampled reviews analyzed in each period.

language.title: Review language
language.description: Steam review language. Use all for all available languages.

includeOffTopicReviews.title: Include off-topic reviews
includeOffTopicReviews.description: Include reviews Steam marks as off-topic activity.

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence
includeEvidence.description: Include up to two short review snippets per major theme.
